verdict.rationale: Statsig documents its own official CLI for managing Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs, and the docs say it can run in CI/CD pipelines to automate that management. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation exists. missing for 10: a command reference or installation/auth details, CLI features aimed at AI agents (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
